description: This file defines types, interfaces, enums, and utility functions for the core data models of the Notesnook project, including items like notes, notebooks, tags, attachments, user info, and related structures.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Type guard to check if an item is a DeletedItem.

methods.name: isTrashItem
methods.description: Type guard to check if an item is a TrashItem.

methods.name: isGroupHeader
methods.description: Type guard to check if an item is a GroupHeader.

methods.name: isGroupingKey
methods.description: Type guard to check if a key is a valid GroupingKey.

methods.name: isDecryptedContent
methods.description: Checks if NoteContent is decrypted (data is not cipher).

methods.name: isEncryptedContent
methods.description: Checks if NoteContent is encrypted (data is cipher).

methods.name: planToId
methods.description: Converts a SubscriptionPlan enum to its corresponding string ID.
